description: Parkeringsplats Rörelsehindrad is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Skövde kommun. Parking spaces reserved for holders of disabled parking permits in Skövde urban area, with geometry and metadata. Coordinates in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Coverage: Skövde kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Parking lot Disabled" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Skövde kommun. Its keywords include Disability, Parkering, Parking, Handikapp. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2025-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
